steps.text: Round 4, S2: a Skip day from the office mid-shift (the clock started on AVAILABLE, a traveller at the desk) lands exactly as a skip of the same day from the briefing: the same day, phase, money, clerkDebtPaid, statement rows and save (but what presenting a traveller may mark: a premade met, a returner, the guide). The skipped day is closed once, by the route: until the landing day's own report the only day end handled is the landing day's. Two fresh runs of the golden seed; flowSettled waits for the shutter after each reloading step (S3)
